Name: Mirror Valley
Author: Azxs121
Description:
Mirror Valley reflects Stardew Valley’s world left to right and adjusts movement and mouse targeting to match. It includes readability fixes for audited English signs, dialogue, festival artwork, and movie captions. The Enable mod switch applies immediately when saved.

Installation
Install SMAPI 4.1.10 or later, extract the MirrorValley folder into Stardew Valley/Mods, and launch through SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and lets you change settings from the title screen or in-game Options.

Beta scope
Built and checked against Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Windows. Automated checks cover rendering hooks, artwork and settings. Full live coverage, other languages and third-party retextures are still unverified. If you report a bug, include the location or scene, UI scale and SMAPI log.

AI disclosure
OpenAI Codex generated most of the mod’s C# code, tests and release documentation, including this description. The beta uses the game’s installed artwork at runtime.
